title: Rimac Nevera vs Bugatti Tourbillon: Electric vs V16
description:
One of these cars has a battery that weighs seven hundred kilograms. The other has an engine with sixteen cylinders that weighs two hundred fifty-two. One costs about two million euros. The other costs three point eight million. And, by our own arithmetic, the one with less power is the one with more power for every kilogram it carries. This is the Rimac Nevera against the Bugatti Tourbillon. Here is the twist that most comparisons miss. Both cars come from the same company family. Mate Rimac, who built the Nevera, is also the chief executive of Bugatti Rimac, the company behind the Tourbillon. So one man is behind both answers to the same question: what is the future of the hypercar?

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.
